description: This file defines the I18NImportError entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including its properties, ORM mapping annotations, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: I18NImportError
classes.description: Entity class representing import error records related to internationalization (i18n) in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Retrieves the language string associated with the error.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Associates a language string with this error.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language associated with this error.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for this error.

methods.name: getImportedBy
methods.description: Returns the employee who imported the record.

methods.name: setImportedBy
methods.description: Sets the employee who imported the record.
